A simple belief✳
01 / Philosophy

Design is not decoration. It is the decision about what people notice, understand, and remember.

Every type choice, colour, image and layout has a job to do. I like work that looks considered, communicates clearly and gives a brand its own recognisable voice.

Clarity first / Craft always

03 / The person behind the pixels

Thoughtful
by nature.
Precise
by craft.

I’m Steven Ogechukwuka Ikem — a graphic designer and visual communication specialist with over five years of experience.

My work spans brand identity development, corporate communications design, marketing collateral, digital media and print. I combine creative judgement with an understanding of the message, the audience and the organisation behind every brief.

I enjoy collaborating with people and teams to make complex ideas easier to understand, brands more recognisable and communication more effective. For me, strong design is where strategy and detail meet.

Good design earns attention.
Great design gives it direction.“ ”
